name: sidebar-list
description: A sets sidebar: a 280px column with a 60px head (title, collapse toggle) over a scrolling list of sidebar-item type="set" rows, optionally opened by a 56px create row. Collapses to a 64px strip.

props.name: title
props.description: Head title, shown at half opacity.

props.name: create
props.description: Label of the create row, the first item of the list (a primary text-button in a type="set" sidebar-item with data-role="create"). Omit for none. Its height is the pane heads' (56px), so it lines up with them.

props.name: items
props.description: Set rows: { name, saved, active, href?, save? } -- href/save pass through to sidebar-item type="set" (see its meta.json): href makes the row a link, save=false drops its save button.

rationale: Width is spacing.9 x 7 (280px), collapsed spacing.row + 2 x spacing.cell (64px). The head is 60px (spacing.9 + spacing.6, changed from 56px on 2026-10-11 so it lines up with the page head beside it) with 10px padding and one hairline below; the optional create row is 56px (spacing.9 + spacing.5, the pane head's height) and every other row keeps the sidebar-item height; the title is the "title" role (Inter SemiBold 16px) at half opacity; the toggle is a 44 x 40px bordered button holding the accent-colored arrow (a CSS mask, so it takes the accent color), flipped when collapsed. The list has no rules between rows: only the active set is ruled, inside sidebar-item, so the one row that matters stands out. Surface is bg.surface with a right hairline in object-dark.passive in both themes (the design has no separate dark value yet). Collapse behavior and its ARIA state live in component.js; choosing and saving sets is the host page's concern (sidebar-item exposes data-select-set / data-save-set hooks). Replaces an earlier Penpot card sidebar. Rendering verified in light and dark themes. Collapsed (updated 2026-10-12): the sidebar stays a 64px strip in the page flow; the toggle slides the full panel open over the page (clip-path 200ms, data-peek) without moving the layout, and a click outside, Escape or choosing a row closes it. The create row follows Figma D_SYSTEM 28:1729: 45px, bold dotted-underlined name, the save icon cell, a closing hairline.
a11y_notes: An <aside> with aria-label. The toggle is a real button with aria-expanded and a label that flips between Collapse sidebar and Expand sidebar; each set row's name and save buttons are real buttons (the save button uses aria-pressed).
